questions.question: In an optimization model, what is a model parameter?
options: A quantity whose value the model is meant to choose
The objective value that the best plan achieves
A requirement that every allowed plan must meet
A given numerical input, not chosen by the model

questions.question: A model uses a demand forecast of 500 units as a parameter, although the true demand is uncertain. What does solving the model with this value give?
options: A plan that is best for any demand that occurs
A plan in which the model has corrected the forecast
A plan that is best if demand really is exactly 500
A plan that is unaffected by the forecast's value

questions.question: In a production model, the cost per unit of one raw material rises. Which effects can this parameter change have?
options: Only the optimal value, while the best plan stays put
Both the best plan and the optimal value may change
Only the best plan, while its profit stays the same
Nothing, since given inputs never affect the result

questions.question: A model chooses units $x_1,x_2$ of two products, with profit $z=12x_1+9x_2$ and machine constraint $3x_1+2x_2\le60$ (hours). What does the number 2 in the constraint represent?
options: The number of units of product 2 produced
The machine hours available for product 2
The profit earned per unit of product 2
Machine hours used per unit of product 2

questions.question: A machine is available for 40 hours per week. A model chooses the units $x_1,x_2$ of two products to make over a 4-week period; one unit uses 3 and 2 machine hours respectively. Which right-hand side $b$ completes the machine constraint $3x_1+2x_2\le b$?
options: $b=160$ hours
$b=40$ hours
$b=10$ hours
$b=2400$ hours

questions.question: A firm chooses output $x$ with $0\le x\le50$ to make profit $(p-4)x$ as large as possible, where the price $p$ is a parameter. If $p$ falls from 6 to 3, what are the new best output and profit?
options: $x^*=50$, with profit $-50$
$x^*=50$, with profit 100
$x^*=50$, with profit 150
$x^*=0$, with profit 0

questions.question: Product 1 uses 3 kg of flour and 2 eggs per batch; product 2 uses 1 kg of flour and 4 eggs per batch; 40 eggs are available. With $x_1,x_2$ the batches made, which constraint limits the eggs used?
A school decides how many classes $x_1,x_2,x_3$ to open in maths, physics and chemistry. It has 12 classrooms, and every class takes 25 students. Which of these is a model parameter?
options: The number $x_1$ of maths classes opened
The 25 students that each class takes
The total $x_1+x_2+x_3$ of classes
The best number of classes overall

questions.question: In a profit model only the available machine hours $b$ change; all objective coefficients stay the same. Can the optimal profit change?
options: No; profit depends only on the objective coefficients
No; a change of $b$ can only move the best plan, not the profit
Yes; $b$ changes which plans are allowed, and so the best value
Yes, but only when $b$ decreases, never when it increases

questions.question: In a model, only the objective coefficient $c_1$ changes; all constraint parameters stay the same. How does this affect which plans are allowed?
options: Not at all; only constraints decide what is allowed
Fewer plans become allowed when $c_1$ goes up
More plans become allowed when $c_1$ goes up
It depends on whether the new $c_1$ is positive or not

questions.question: Product 1 needs 2 hours and product 2 needs 30 minutes on a machine available for 10 hours; $x_1,x_2$ are the units made. A model writes $2x_1+30x_2\le10$. Which constraint is correct?

Shipping costs per unit $c_{ij}$ from depot $i$ to shop $j$ are $c_{11}=4$, $c_{12}=6$, $c_{21}=5$, $c_{22}=3$. A plan ships $x_{11}=10$, $x_{12}=0$, $x_{21}=5$, $x_{22}=8$ units. What is its total cost $\sum_{i,j}c_{ij}x_{ij}$?
The parameters of a production model are estimates. Which errors in them can make the model's plan impossible to carry out, rather than merely not the best?
options: Errors in the objective coefficients only
Errors of any kind, in every parameter
Errors in constraint coefficients or available amounts
No errors, since the plan meets the model's constraints

questions.question: After the objective coefficient $c_1$ of a profit model rises slightly, the optimal value rises but the best plan stays the same. Is this possible?
options: Yes; it happens when the best plan has $x_1>0$
No; a new optimal value requires a new plan
Yes, but only when the best plan has $x_1=0$
No; changing $c_1$ never changes the optimal value

questions.question: A product sells for 10 and costs 6 per unit made; unsold units are worthless. A model with demand parameter 120 recommends making 120 units, predicting profit 480. Actual demand is 100. What profit does the plan actually earn?
